request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Early in the morning Abraham got up before the light
Saddled up the donkey, split the wood and tied it tight
Took the boy he loved, his only son, and walked for three long days
Till he saw the mountain rising in the distance through the haze
The LORD will provide

[Verse]
He laid the wood on Isaac and he took the fire and knife
The boy looked up and asked him on the road toward the height
Father, here's the fire and wood, but where is the lamb to slay
God himself will provide the lamb, my son, and they walked on their way
The LORD will provide

[Verse]
He built an altar on the hill and laid the wood in place
He bound the boy and raised the knife with sorrow on his face
An angel of the LORD called out, Abraham, from the sky
And there behind him in a thicket was a ram caught nearby
The LORD will provide

[Verse]
Do not lay a hand on the boy, now I know that you fear God
You have not withheld your only son, and the ram was caught and brought
Abraham offered up the ram instead of his own son
And he named that place on the mountain for what the LORD had done
The LORD will provide
